name: Black Pearl Seafood Chophouse

evidence.note: Restaurant calendar lists In the Groove on Sunday Oct 4, 3-6 PM, plus other weekend bands.
In The Groove's listing for an earlier Black Pearl show tells fans to bring their dancing shoes.
A dance-party band lists a Black Pearl date; its blurb promises to pack the dance floor (band's own words, not the venue's).

dancing.notes: Party cover bands play here often and invite people to dance. We could not confirm how much open floor there is, so call ahead if dancing matters to you.

description: A waterfront seafood and steak restaurant inside Danford's Hotel & Marina in Port Jefferson village. It has a bar, outdoor seating by the harbor and live bands most weekends.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Chose the Port Jefferson Black Pearl because In The Groove plays there often and its calendar lists In the Groove on Oct 4 (venue says 3-6 PM; Ira says 3-8 PM). A 'Black Pearl Lounge' in Baldwin is permanently closed.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Hours conflict on the contact page: one block says dining/bar Sun-Thu 11:30 AM-10 PM and Fri-Sat to 11 PM, the footer says restaurant daily to 10 PM and bar/lounge to 11 PM Sun-Thu and 1 AM Fri-Sat; we used the footer. The site's email address is hidden (obfuscated), so no email recorded. The sales office line (631) 676-7024 belongs to Pearl at Danford's catering (pearlcatering.events). The site is built on a restaurant template and still shows some placeholder demo text and images (team photos, sample menu) which we ignored. Photo 1 shows the whole Danford's property, which includes the restaurant. The site has an events calendar with an iCal feed: https://blackpearlportjeff.com/events/?ical=1.
hours: Restaurant daily 11:30 AM-10 PM; bar/lounge Sun-Thu 11:30 AM-11 PM, Fri-Sat 11:30 AM-1 AM; happy hour Mon-Fri 3-6 PM
